_comment: The Store identity for the MSIX. identity_name, publisher and publisher_display_name must be copied exactly from Partner Center: Product management -> Product Identity (Package/Identity/Name, Package/Identity/Publisher, Package/Properties/PublisherDisplayName). The Store rejects a package whose identity differs from the reservation. The package version is zen_version (src/calibre/constants.py) plus '.0': the Store needs four parts, a 0 last, and an increase on every submission, so a resubmission bumps zen_version.
description: A modern calibre for people who love ebooks. Installs beside calibre; your libraries, settings and plugins do not move.
